prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a production atlas of TWENTY circular illustrated game tokens, exactly FIVE columns and FOUR rows, read left to right then top to bottom. This is for Creation, an original myth in which four elemental powers become stars, a living planet and independent minds. Make an exquisite coherent family in luminous opaque gouache with selective fine ink contours, ultramarine night grounds, jade and turquoise, burnt ochre, muted coral, warm ivory highlights. Restrained narrow ivory-gold circular rims. Strong silhouettes, large intelligible forms, very little tiny detail; beautiful and readable when each circle is only 64 pixels across. Neither glossy 3D coins nor flat generic pictograms. Each token is a complete perfect circle centered in its equal grid cell, diameter 78 percent of the shorter cell dimension. Transparent empty space OUTSIDE every circle; rich opaque painted ground INSIDE. Generous uniform gutters, no overlapping circles, no shadows outside circles. Landscape sheet preferably 2000 by 1600 pixels. No text, labels, numbers, grid lines, letters or watermark. Each cell contains ONLY its listed subject; do not merge scenes. Exact order: ROW 1: (1) Earth, elemental matter: a compact angular ochre rock with a few coarse mineral grains, no planet and no soil plant. (2) Air, elemental motion: three graceful broad pale wind ribbons curling through deep blue empty space, no clouds, no wings. (3) Fire, elemental energy: one upright coral-and-gold flame, clearly pointed flame tongue. (4) Water, elemental change: one large turquoise droplet and a single circular ripple. (5) First star: one brilliant ivory-gold star sphere with a soft corona on deep ultramarine, no crescent, no flame. ROW 2: (6) Galaxy: a tilted spiral with two clear luminous arms and many tiny star points, no planet. (7) Moon: a pale cratered moon disk with one recognizable pair of unequal adjacent dark craters, lit crescent on right. (8) Living cell: one translucent jade oval boundary with simple internal granules and coiled thread, no visible nucleus, no medical or laboratory objects. (9) Dividing cells: the SAME simple jade cell pinching deeply into two equal lobes with duplicated granules, unmistakable division. (10) Partnered cells: one larger teal cell enclosing two clearly distinct tiny ochre bacterial ovals; close symbiotic interior, not cell division. ROW 3: (11) First forest: a group of tall fern-like trees with splayed fronds and straight trunks, lush green, no flowers. (12) Fallen forest: the SAME fern-like tree trunks broken and laid diagonally on dark earth, no healthy standing canopy, no fire. (13) Pioneer woodland: a few smaller young green broadleaf trees with much open sunlit ground between, not a dense mature forest. (14) Sea cave: a hooked ochre sea cliff with a single dark arched wave-cut entrance, teal tide beneath and a pale DRY upper wall inside, no painting, people or buildings. (15) Great browsers: two large long-necked four-legged herbivorous sauropod-like animals, one full clear silhouette and one smaller distant companion, rounded heavy feet, no horns, no humans. ROW 4: (16) Last tracks: a short trail of fresh ROUND deep giant footprints ending in dark wet mud; empty landscape, no living dinosaurs, no three-toed bird prints. (17) Fossil footprints: the SAME pattern of rounded footprints now impressed in a tilted ochre stone slab with two visible sediment layers; dry rock, not wet mud, no animals. (18) Song: one warm human head in side silhouette releasing a single coral-and-gold flowing sound ribbon, no written notes or instruments. (19) Remembered song: an older and a younger warm human profile facing the same direction, a single matching coral-and-gold ribbon passing from the elder to the younger; oral inheritance, no books, no notes. (20) Changed song: the younger singer alone, ribbon beginning as the SAME coral-and-gold curve but then branching upward into a NEW turquoise ending; recognizable variation of the song, no printed musical notation. All people are small symbolic warm earth-coloured figures without detailed faces or modern clothing. Keep the twenty rims, painted finish, scale and visual weight consistent.
